videos.summary: Day in the Life of UTB property managers: rooftop hard-hat walk by the Gothic spires, tenant meetings, lobby, sidewalk inspections, each with a bold role caption.

videos.summary: Day in the Life Part 2 (Midday): marquee intro, Freshii bowl, Mellon Park walk, flower-wall swings at Ritual House, a tenant seminar.

takeaways: There is no UTB work on the site yet. For a new work/union-trust-building page, lead with the Q Theatre 'Revised' Caligari reel and Day in the Life Part 1 (Morning), with History with Charles (the vault) as the signature series and the Make-A-Wish recap as the proof point ($8k raised). Use the top-down rotunda spiral (Opening Ceremony cell 18, the only 5) as the cover, with the lit night exterior (cell 6) or the glowing marquee (HH 2024 cell 29) as the alternate. The building's architecture is the hero-loop gift: clean vertical rotunda tilts (HH 2024 video 30, Sept-Jan 351, Opening Ceremony 22), the vault-door move (April 2024 cell 41), the 0:17 atrium glide in DITL Part 1, and the Mellon Square drone clip once someone confirms it. The DITL series and the branded Staff Spotlight/Tenant Testimonial covers prove service:organic-social. Most of the rest (vendor tables, tenant-logo walls, Live Photo pairs, Peloton and cocktail reels) should stay off the site.
